items.description:
Resmoke Services is a Centurion-based appliance repair company that services household appliances on site, with same-day express repairs and collect-and-deliver options. The company was founded in 2016 and presents itself as a fair and honest repair service that treats the customer's home with care from the front gate through to the kitchen and entertainment area.

Bookings and invoicing are handled online, each job is kept in a service and repair history, and parts and labour carry a standard three-month warranty. The team works with professional tools and equipment, and the company also offers to collect unwanted appliances and provides paperless operations. It suits households in Centurion and the surrounding area who want a repair booked, invoiced and warranted without the usual back-and-forth, and the business is based in Valhalla.

items.reason: Only the magicpin and medpages directory pages were found, and they describe the Ringpharm group in general terms. Nothing branch-specific about the Centurion Crescent pharmacy's services or trading hours was retrieved.

Own site was not found; the only source is an auto-repair directory profile with a single 5-star review and no service detail. The specialisms in the current text are not confirmed by any retrieved page.

items.description:
Safety and Overall Warehouse supplies personal protective equipment and workwear, along with custom branding for uniforms, signage and vehicles. Its PPE range covers high-visibility clothing, hard hats and bump caps, safety footwear, gloves for cut, chemical and thermal protection, and eye, face and hearing protection.

The business says it brings protection and promotion together under one roof, with in-house design, printing and embroidery. Its services include apparel branding, signage solutions and vehicle wrapping, and it advertises fast turnaround, premium materials and full customisation to a client's exact needs. It suits site teams, workshops and businesses that want safety-compliant gear and branded materials from one supplier, and the warehouse is on Kamelia Road in Karenpark, Pretoria.

Saintsburg is an online and hybrid homeschooling provider for learners aged 6 to 18, preparing students for International GCSE and AS and A-Level examinations. Its courses run by age, from early starters and junior courses to priming, the International GCSE, an exam preparation year and AS and beyond, and each student can choose between Cambridge and Pearson Edexcel examination boards.

Learning can be live online with a timetabled teacher, self-paced online, or in person at the onsite campus, which has limited places. The school says its tutors are practitioners by degree and educators by choice, and it reports supporting more than 11,800 families. It suits families who want a qualification recognised internationally with flexible structure and personal support, and the campus is on Achilles Street in Zwavelpoort, Pretoria.

The Sammy Marks Museum is a Victorian mansion museum at Zwartkoppies Hall, about 23 kilometres outside Pretoria, in the Donkerhoek area. The house was built by a pioneer industrialist after he bought the Zwartkoppies farm in 1884, and it is a 48-room home with lush gardens and tennis courts.

The estate became a museum in 1986 and is preserved as a house museum that shows the opulent life of the family who lived there, along with the period furnishings and the broader story of Victorian wealth in South Africa. It is one of the country's tourist attractions for those interested in old-world charm and the mining and industrial history of the Transvaal. It suits history lovers, school groups and visitors who want a guided look at a preserved Victorian estate on the edge of Pretoria.

SandblastZA offers mobile wet and dry sandblasting for surface preparation, rust and residual contaminant removal, and coating preparation. The page describes sandblasting as the cleaning and roughening of surfaces before coating, and it notes that the service removes scale and debris that would otherwise prevent a proper finish.

The business also hires out sandblasting equipment, including a 200-litre pot and a compressor rated at 400 cfm, with hoses, nozzles and face masks, on daily, weekly or monthly rates. It can supply the grit as well, and the page advises that a compressor of at least 250 cfm is needed to power the pot. It suits contractors and maintenance teams who need the work done on site or want to run their own blasting, and the business is based at Sakabuka Avenue in Derdepoort Smallholdings.

Sefeko is a South African technology company that makes voice-first operations tools for frontline teams, built around rugged push-to-talk radios. The radios run over cellular and Wi-Fi networks and are paired with live GPS tracking, guard monitoring and an operations platform for security, facilities, mining and logistics teams.

The platform adds real-time location mapping, NFC and RFID route tracking, incident management, data analytics and reporting, and secure conversation recording and playback. The company says the products are made in South Africa and offers a free trial. It suits managers who need to see where their teams are, monitor guard rounds and manage incidents as they happen, and the company operates from the Techno Park in Persequor, Pretoria.

Self Storage is a Pretoria East storage provider that stores goods in converted shipping containers, which the company says seal securely, keep out dust and stay waterproof. It offers a variety of unit sizes at reasonable rates, on well maintained premises with access to the unit throughout the year.

Rentals run from a one-month minimum with no limit on how long a customer can keep a unit, so the service suits both short-term needs and long-term storage. The company's terms and sizes are published on the site, along with a reservation form for booking a unit. It suits households moving house, businesses holding stock and anyone who needs dry, secure space close to the eastern suburbs, and the storage yard is on Meerlust Road in Willow Glen.

SeniNhle Occupational Health Services is an approved inspection authority for occupational health and hygiene, set up in 2000 to help employers protect the health and safety of their staff. Its services include occupational health and hygiene risk assessments, the development of occupational health and hygiene programmes, and safety programme development for workplaces.

The company also provides medical surveillance, which it describes as part of a wider approach to managing employee health and the future liabilities that can follow from illness. It says that businesses which invest in the health of their employees are investing in their own sustainability. It suits employers who must meet occupational health and hygiene legislation and want a specialist inspection partner, and the office is on Vercueil Street in Garsfontein, Pretoria.

SEOPros is a search engine optimisation and digital marketing agency in Muckleneuk, Pretoria. Its services include local SEO, city-focused SEO for Pretoria, Johannesburg and South Africa, app SEO and blog content, along with PPC and Google Ads management, website design and website hosting.

The agency also offers AI automation and auto lead generation, and it publishes its SEO process and articles on how search engines treat content and site architecture. Its site describes a KPI-driven team that focuses on organic growth, so the work is measured against search results and enquiries rather than impressions alone. It suits businesses that want to rank higher on Google, both locally and nationally, and the office is at Boshoff Street in Nieuw Muckleneuk.

Sephaku Cement is a cement producer powered by Dangote Cement, making general-purpose and road-stabilisation cements for construction across Southern Africa. Its product range includes Sephaku 32, a 32.5R general-purpose blended cement for concrete, mortar, plaster and screed, along with other strength classes and SepROAD, which is formulated to stabilise a broad range of road materials.

The products are described as complying with SANS 50197-1, and the company publishes a product brochure, safety data sheets, SABS certificates and a cement calculator for planning. It also lists its manufacturing plants, sustainability and compliance information, and tender notices. It suits builders, contractors and road projects that need certified cement with a clear specification, and the head office is in Southdowns Office Park, Irene, Centurion.

Shepherd Removals and Deliveries is a removals company in Pretoria offering household moves, office relocations and long-distance moving across Gauteng and nationwide. Its services include careful loading and delivery for homes, townhouses, apartments and estates, structured office moves, and professional packing with boxes, tape, wrap and covers.

Clients can work through a detailed inventory calculator on the site, which captures access, stairs, lifts and truck restrictions, so the quote reflects the real move. The company also rents reusable moving crates on a kit basis, delivered before the move and collected afterwards, then cleaned and sanitised for the next customer. It suits families and businesses who want a clear quote and a planned move, and the office is on Havelock Road in Willow Park Manor.

Sign Image is a corporate and franchise signage company in Centurion, established in 1996. It designs, fabricates, installs and maintains signage for corporate, franchise and retail clients, including illuminated signs, and its work covers single storefronts through to national rollouts across South Africa and the wider SADC region.

The company describes one accountable partner for national programmes, a consistent visual system for every location, and an in-house production process that keeps design, fabrication and installation in one place. It is a level 4 B-BBEE contributor, and its selected work includes brand environments for restaurant and retail groups. It suits brands that need signage to look the same in every branch, and the business is based at Vlakvark Street in Zwartkop, Centurion.

Specialist Mechanical Engineers is a thermal and power management firm that designs and manufactures heating, ventilation, air-conditioning and power distribution systems for demanding environments. Its work covers specialised thermal and air-handling systems built for extreme heat, heavy particulate loads and continuous duty, as well as dependable HVAC for controlled environments in critical infrastructure.

The firm serves the railway and rolling stock, defence and protection, mining, smelter and foundry, automotive and civil security sectors. Its products include systems for security and defence vehicles, mining and smelter equipment, containers and shelters, trains and trams, locomotives and passenger coaches. It suits engineers and operators who need reliable systems for vehicles and plant that face vibration, dust and tough duty cycles, and the firm is based on Hertzog Street in Rietfontein, Pretoria.

Sperosens is a group of companies that provides fire protection and telemetry solutions to the mining and industrial sectors across Africa. It was founded in 1988, and its work covers gas and flame detection, respirable dust and ambient air monitoring, smoke sensors, sound-level sensors, distributed temperature sensing and fire suppression for special risks.

The group designs its engineered solutions using in-house intellectual property or by integrating standard components into complete systems, and offers system design, project implementation and term service agreements. It is ISO 9001:2015 certified and serves clients in a number of African countries, operating from a head office in Centurion with branches in Klerksdorp, eMalahleni, Rustenburg and other mining towns, plus satellite stations near project sites. It suits mines, smelters and industrial plants that need monitoring and protection they can rely on, and the head office is at Highway Business Park in Centurion.

items.reason: About page gives only a general line (property development, facility management, sales and rentals across South Africa) repeated twice. No office park, project or track-record specifics for the Hazeldean office were retrieved; the page's own text would need padding to reach 100 words.

Site gave only property search drop-downs and a short about line, which names a different office location (Mayville) from the listing address. Not enough consistent sourced detail on the agency's areas or services.
Site is marked as a work in progress and gives only category names and a generic supplier paragraph. The 30-year claim is the only specific fact, and a description built on that would be padding.

items.description:
Strategic Marketing Tribe is a StoryBrand marketing agency for service-based founders, helping them move away from feast-or-famine client flow and toward a steady pipeline of pre-sold clients. Its offering is built around a failure-proof marketing system, a strategy-first engagement, a trust-building system, StoryBrand marketing and a StoryBrand course, with a total online presence audit as a starting point.

The agency publishes free marketing guides, a free five-minute marketing fix and a self-test that identifies weak points and produces a free action plan. Its approach is aimed at experts who are trapped in an unpredictable revenue cycle and want clients who already trust them before they buy. It suits consultants, coaches and other service-based professionals who want a clear marketing system rather than random tactics, and the agency is based on Dunhill Street in Waterkloof Glen, Pretoria.

Sunbird Media is a creative and digital agency in Pretoria offering web development, graphic design and branding, and web hosting, with domain hosting and design packages. Its portfolio includes sports designs, theatre and show work, mockups and invitations, and the site includes an online shop with checkout for ordering designs.

The agency says its designers and developers build custom solutions that aim to look good and deliver measurable results, starting from an understanding of the client's business and target audience. Alongside design and development it offers Google AdWords setup, social media management and email marketing, so the online presence and its promotion are handled together. It suits businesses that want a new website, a refresh of an existing one or help with online marketing, and the agency is based at Shirley Avenue East in Murrayfield, with a listing in Die Wilgers.

items.reason: Own site did not resolve. The only other source is a directory entry with no description, and the remaining search results are SPAR catalogues and dictionary pages. No source describes the Pretoria West business.

items.description:
SuperPump is a water pump supplier and installer in Gezina, Pretoria, selling and installing water pumps and solar pumps for South African and African markets. Its range covers borehole pumps and motors, sewage and wastewater pumps, horizontal and vertical multistage pumps, end-suction and close-coupled pumps, peripheral and centrifugal pumps, swimming pool pumps and fountain pumps.

The company also stocks irrigation equipment for residential and commercial use, and it offers full turnkey solutions for water pumps and related products. Its website includes practical guides on how each pump type works and where it is used, which helps buyers choose the right model. It suits homeowners with boreholes, farms, irrigation projects and commercial or industrial clients who need a pump supplied and installed, and the business is on Johan Heyns Drive in Gezina.

Takgalang Consulting is a built-environment consultancy founded in 2007 and operating from Heuwelsig Office Park in Heuwelsig Estate, Pretoria. Its services include construction project management, quantity surveying, construction health and safety, and concrete pump services covering access studies, pump selection, pour planning and placement oversight.

The firm says it has delivered over 200 projects and appointed more than 600 contracts, with completed works worth about R15 billion. Its project management covers programme control, coordination and reporting, its quantity surveying covers cost planning, bills of quantities, valuations and final accounts, and its safety work covers plans, audits, method statements and incident management. It describes itself as a 100 percent black-owned firm with a BEE Level 1 rating, which suits developers, contractors and public clients who need programme and cost control from first plan to final handover.

items.reason: Only the site's pricing URL was targeted, and it timed out. The About page returned 404, and the only text retrieved was navigation and footer copy. The fixed-fee package claims were not confirmed on any retrieved page.

items.description:
Team Building Go is a corporate events company in Ashlea Gardens, Pretoria, offering team-building activities such as The Amazing Race, escape rooms, Minute to Win It, MasterChef competitions and Survivor-style challenges. Its Amazing Race packages are run in Gauteng venues including Fourways, Sandton and Montecasino, and are described as suitable for all ages with low physical requirements.

The company says its quotes are all inclusive, covering parking, entry, coffee and snacks, and a lunch, with a one-stop approach to planning. It also offers deeper team-building packages aimed at growth strategy, business profiling and performance outcomes. It suits companies that want a structured day out for staff, from light activity-based events to packages linked to business goals, and the business is based on Tugela Road in Ashlea Gardens.

Teqco is an IT and business-management consultancy in Doornpoort, Pretoria, offering private cloud hosting in South Africa, backend and end-user IT support, custom IoT hardware and software development, and specialist IT project management. Its focus is on business enablement and data rights, with the stated principle that a client's data remains the client's data.

The company hosts systems inside South Africa for South African businesses, which it says keeps data within the country and under local control, and it supports small and medium businesses and government agencies with day-to-day backend and user support. Its project management is handled by IT architects and project managers, and it also maps business processes and designs system architecture. It suits South African businesses that want cloud services with data sovereignty and a local IT partner, and the office is on Lindveldt Road.

Terotechnica is an accredited asset management and maintenance college in Montana Park, Pretoria, offering courses in maintenance engineering and physical asset management. Its programmes include accredited asset management courses, maintenance certification, CMMS training, reliability engineering and maintenance management, designed for engineers, supervisors and maintenance professionals.

The college offers diplomas and short courses, runs in-house courses for companies that want training delivered on their own site, and takes international students. Its site sets out a philosophy that training is central to maintenance performance and to business efficiency, and it publishes diploma subject choices, rules for diploma study and a course calendar for the coming year. It suits maintenance staff who want a recognised qualification and companies that want their teams trained to international standards, and the college is at Firethorn Street in Montana Park.

That Couch Place is a locally made furniture manufacturer selling corner, division, sleeper, U-shape and other couches, beds, mattresses, tables and chairs. Its hospitality range is aimed at hotels, guesthouses, Airbnb hosts and resorts, with furnishings built to handle heavy use while keeping a comfortable, luxurious feel.

The range also includes memory foam mattress toppers, platinum mattress and base sets, lumbar-support beds and oversized two-seater couches, and the site sorts products by category and by room, including bedroom, lounge, dining and bar and outdoor. Its pet products sit alongside the furniture range. It suits home buyers who want locally made furniture, as well as operators who need durable pieces for guest rooms, and the shop is at Tshwane Mall on Moloto Road in Derdepoort.

The Golf Lab is a golf retailer and custom club-fitting service in Woodhill Golf Estate, Pretoria. Fittings are booked by appointment, and the store sells new and pre-owned clubs across the bag, including drivers, fairways, hybrids, utility irons, irons, wedges and putters.

The company says it offers custom-fitted clubs that match each golfer's swing, and it stocks premium gear and golf accessories alongside the clubs. Shoppers can buy online or visit the store, and the site includes a trade-in option for existing equipment. It suits golfers who want a fitting before buying or a used set from the pre-owned range, and the store is in Unit 7 on Woodhill Drive in Garsfontein.

The Hammer Effect is a renovation and custom furnishing business in Centurion, offering 3D design, custom furniture, carpentry and flooring installation. Its 3D service produces a floor plan and a visual representation of a project before work starts, so a client can see the result in advance.

The furniture range includes sofas, ottomans and coffee tables made to order, and the carpentry work covers built-in units, island tops, shelving and decor accents. Its flooring service imports materials and includes professional installation. The company says it works from a commitment to quality and craftsmanship and sets out to turn each client's vision into a finished home. It suits homeowners who want a remodel or custom pieces designed around their space, and the business is on Petrus Myburgh Street in Erasmia.

The Screwman is an industrial fastener and tool supplier in Rosslyn, Pretoria, trading since 1974. Its range covers bolts, nuts, washers, anchors, threaded rod and studs, machine screws, self-tapping screws and roofing fasteners, with pins and grease nipples, to DIN and ISO specifications and in a range of sizes, grades and finishes.

The business also stocks hand tools, sockets, drill bits and cutting and abrasives, power tools, welding and soldering supplies, adhesives and sealants, and safety and workwear. It supports trade, workshop and factory customers with account orders, bulk supply and quotes on special-order items. It suits fitters, engineers and workshops that need the right fastener first time, and its counter is in Rosslyn with local collection options.

Themba Property Group is a real estate agency in Thatchfield Ridge, Centurion, handling sales and rentals across residential, commercial, industrial, mixed-use, agricultural and vacant land property in the Pretoria and Johannesburg area. Its site groups its listings by these categories, from residential homes for sale and to let to farms, smallholdings and vacant stands.

The agency publishes a company profile, bond and other property calculators, an agent search and property email alerts for buyers and tenants who want updates on new listings. Its featured properties include family homes and townhouses to let and for sale, and the agency describes itself as a practice that negotiates commission without compromising on professionalism. It suits buyers, sellers, landlords and tenants in the greater Pretoria area who want a specialist agency across several property types, and the office is on Blue Daisy Street in Thatchfield Ridge.

Tileba Vleismark is a family-run butchery in Tileba, Pretoria, supplying fresh beef, lamb, pork and chicken along with boerewors, droewors, biltong and game processing. The shop keeps fresh stock daily, cuts meat to order and offers braai packs, with a choice of packs for groups of four, eight or sixteen people.

It sells at both wholesale and retail prices, and its game processing is done by experienced hands from field to freezer. The business says it has supplied the community with fresh, quality meat since the day it opened, and it sets out its honest meat and honest service in the product pages. It suits families planning a braai, caterers and hunters who need game processed, and the shop is at Wouter Street in Tileba, Pretoria.

items.reason: Site was blocked by Cloudflare on every request. Only chain-wide pages (brands, group ownership) were found in search results; nothing about the Irene Village Mall store itself.
Store page is blocked by Cloudflare and no other source describes the Wonderboom Junction branch. Chain-wide facts alone are not allowed for a retail branch.

items.description:
Tritechnium is an ICT solutions provider in Rietondale, Pretoria, offering IT support, server and network support, managed IT services and consulting, website development and digital marketing. Its services also include spam control, virus and spyware removal, anti-virus protection, Microsoft service pack installation and on-site or remote help with computer, laptop and notebook repairs.

The company provides data backups to a client's own servers or to a cloud solution, and it describes itself as a cost-effective alternative to a full-time in-house IT department. It serves businesses across Pretoria, Centurion and Johannesburg, with most clients in Gauteng and remote services available further afield. It suits small and medium businesses that need reliable IT support without hiring their own team, and the business is on Russel Street in Rietondale.

Trixie's Café is a café, bakery and bar in Colbyn Village Shopping Centre, Pretoria, with indoor and outdoor seating and in-store collection for its treats. The menu includes breakfast specials and grilled dishes such as a steak eggs benedict topped with a red wine hollandaise, along with a rotating selection of freshly baked cakes.

The café runs a Monday breakfast special that includes eggs, bacon, chips, toast and roasted tomatoes, and a midweek cake and cappuccino special on Wednesdays. Its listing describes a relaxed spot for a cosy gathering or a quick bite, with new cakes added regularly. It suits breakfast and brunch crowds and anyone looking for a treat with their coffee, and the café is on Thomson Street in Colbyn.

Tugela Projects is a building and construction company in Villieria, Pretoria, offering end-to-end services from groundbreaking to handover. Its services include A to Z building, design and build, borehole drilling, renovations, plumbing installation and repair, painting, waterproofing and ceilings, for both new builds and upgrades.

The company says it has completed more than 100 projects over 15 years, and that it works with a team of experienced experts in carpentry, paving and restoration as well as the core building trades. Its site includes a portfolio of recent projects with photographs and videos, and it lists 24/7 support for clients. It suits homeowners and property owners in Gauteng who need a single contractor to take a job from the first excavation to the final finish, and the company is based in Villieria.

Twiga is a South African defence and security engineering company that has provided turnkey acquisition projects for defence, security and humanitarian clients for more than 30 years. Its work transfers technology and skills so that clients can develop their own capabilities, and its products include APC and MRAP vehicles, 4x4 patrol vehicles, rugged patrol boats, weapon mounts and off-road trailers.

The company also offers test and evaluation services and runs technology transfer programmes for international clients. Its products are presented as tailored to demanding operating conditions, and the company works through the transfer of skills to build local capability rather than supplying only finished equipment. It suits defence, security and humanitarian organisations looking for a partner to acquire and build vehicles and systems locally, and the warehouse is on Brander Street in Jan Niemand Park, Pretoria.

items.reason: Chain branch: only company-wide UBS pages were found (ceiling and partitioning supply, national brands). Nothing branch-specific about the Silverton store.

items.description:
Ubuntu eWaste Recycling is an electronic-waste handler in Silverton, Pretoria, that takes electronic and electrical waste, recovers its valuable material and treats hazardous fractions before safe disposal. Its services include eWaste pickup and removal, serialised asset inventories, electrical dismantling, staff buy-backs and charity distribution.

The company offers physical data destruction and software data destruction by zero-filling, which suits businesses that need to dispose of equipment that holds sensitive information. It also buys electronic assets and scrap. The business describes itself as a Level 2 B-BBEE company that acquired the eWaste operation of the Tshwane Electronic Waste Company, which has run since 2012. It suits offices and businesses with redundant IT equipment, and its warehouse is in the Tannery Industrial Park on Derdepoort Road.

Ukhozi Consulting Engineers is a multidisciplinary engineering consultancy in Kilner Park, Pretoria, established in 1998 and known for professionalism, efficiency and reliability. Its services include engineering design, electronic design and integration, and strategic partnerships, and it draws on partner firms when a specialist skill is needed.

The firm merged with SVR Engineers in 2020 to widen its service, and it reports a major-projects record covering the last five years. Its shareholding is majority black-owned and it holds a Level 2 BEE rating. Its mission focuses on improving living conditions in historically disadvantaged communities and supporting coordinated housing, health, education, transport and security infrastructure. It suits public and private clients who need engineering consultants with a strong community focus, and the office is on Freeland Avenue in Kilner Park.

UniqueCo Property Valuers is a national valuation firm based in Val-de-Grace, Pretoria, providing insurance, market and municipal valuations. Its insurance work covers building and content valuations, and its municipal work uses the CAMA system and the Municipal Property Rates Act guidelines to support rates valuations.

The firm also carries out mass valuation assessments, servitude and expropriation assessments, building and development progress assessments and movable property assessments. Its valuations cover residential, commercial, industrial, retail, agricultural, leisure and hotel resort, nature reserve, sectional title, share block and mining property. The firm has national and international partners and offers an online quotation. It suits homeowners, insurers, municipalities and property owners who need an independent valuation for a specific purpose, and the office is on Stamvrug Street.

Urban Cultivation is a hydroponics and indoor-farming company in The Willows, Pretoria, that develops automated hydroponic systems for commercial indoor farms and supplies equipment to home growers. Its commercial work covers indoor farming solutions that grow crops in controlled spaces, with nursery and seedling systems, plant factory systems and climate control.

The retail store supplies grow tents, grow lights, grow kits, nutrients, grow mediums and accessories for hydroponic growing, and the company says it is an official authorised distributor for several brands, including CANNA and BioBizz. Its site also lists dehumidifiers, lighting innovations and vegetable seeds. It suits home growers, nursery operators and commercial farmers who want a controlled growing environment, and the shop is at Banghoek Crescent in N4 Gateway Industrial Park, The Willows.

Vaimo is a digital commerce and customer experience consultancy with offices in Pretoria, part of a global group operating in more than 16 markets. Its services cover commerce strategy, solution development, experience design, analytics and AI-driven insights, support services and experience optimisation, with accelerators that address specific commerce challenges.

The company says it has completed more than 500 projects over 17 years, drawing on 650 specialists, and it holds partner status with Adobe Commerce and Shopify, among others. Its approach joins commerce, content, data and activation, so that a brand's storefront, content and customer data work together. It suits retailers and brands that want to grow their online sales and need a technical partner for a complex commerce platform, and the Pretoria office is at Hillcrest Office Park on Lunnon Road.

Van Heerden and Associates is a Pretoria law firm and attorneys' practice in Wonderboom, with a strong focus on Road Accident Fund claims. Its specialist areas are RAF claims, property law and conveyancing, tax law, family law, and corporate and commercial law, along with correspondent services for other firms.

The firm offers a cost calculator on its site and describes a results-driven approach that aims for personalised service and clear outcomes in each matter. Its correspondent services department supports other attorneys who need representation or work done in Pretoria. It suits individuals injured in road accidents, homebuyers and sellers, families going through separation or divorce, and businesses that need corporate or tax advice, and the offices are at Marija Street in Wonderboom.

VDH Attorneys Incorporated, formerly Van der Hoven Attorneys, is a specialist law firm in Alphen Park, Pretoria, focused on debt review under the National Credit Act. It has been established since 2009 and represents debt counsellors across the country, with court referrals to magistrates' courts for debt-review matters.

The firm says it has handled more than 77,000 debt-review matters and that it secured declaratory relief from the North Gauteng High Court in 2015, a ruling it describes as significant for the debt review industry. It was recognised at the 2015 Debt Review Awards and continues to develop the legal framework for consumers who want to exit debt review. It suits debt counsellors who need a dependable specialist in debt-review court work, and the office is on Umkomaas Road in Alphen Park.

VDW Accountants is a Pretoria accounting firm that supports small and medium enterprises with monthly accounting, SARS tax administration, payroll, CIPC secretarial services and financial management. The firm is led by a SAIPA-qualified professional accountant with over ten years of experience.

Its accounting service produces accurate monthly records and reports, and its tax administration covers SARS registrations, calculations and submissions. Payroll is run with timely SARS submissions, including IRP5 and EMP501 records, and secretarial work covers company registrations and annual returns. Management accounts and budgets are provided for owners who want clear figures to guide decisions. It suits owner-managed businesses that want their books, tax and payroll handled in one place, and the office is on Muller Street in Queenswood, Pretoria.

Vergeet My Nie Verhurings is an event hire business in Eldoraigne, Centurion, with more than 30 years of experience. It supplies event décor, furniture, table settings, centrepieces and backdrops for weddings, birthdays, year-end functions and other occasions, and it can supply invitations and draping as part of a complete look.

The business also runs a laser cutting department, which produces custom signage, table numbers and other personalised pieces to add a finishing touch. The team describes its service as advice-led, helping clients plan from the first invitation through to the décor on the day. It suits couples, families and companies planning an event who want the décor, hire and personalisation handled under one roof, and the business is on Willem Botha Drive in Eldoraigne.
